scenes.title: A day as a salesperson
scenes.subtitle: Sneha sells domestic holidays
scenes.narration: Sneha is a travel consultant. She sees her own leads, her follow-ups and her customers' messages, and spends her day turning enquiries into trips.
Her follow-ups list shows what is due today and anything overdue, with a reminder when each one comes up.
She opens the Desai family's Goa lead, adds a note from this morning's call, and schedules the next follow-up.
The Goa package template fits, so she creates the itinerary from it in one click, already priced.
A customer of hers is travelling abroad, so she shares the contact with Farhan from the international desk. She also sees which customers have a birthday or anniversary coming up.
Finally the inbox: a WhatsApp from a customer, answered with a template in a few seconds.

scenes.headline: More time selling trips.
scenes.cta: Give your consultants a head start
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. More time selling trips.
